title: Pirate Coloring Book for Kids, 24 Treasure Island Adventure Pages, Pirate Ship Parrot Treasure Map, Gift for Ages 4-8
description:
Ahoy, little adventurers! A pirate and treasure island coloring book with 24 big, simple pages: a friendly young captain, pirate ships, a parrot on a treasure chest, a treasure map with a big X, a waving sea monster, a pirate cat, a whale, a sunken ship and a campfire night on the island. Thick, clear outlines and large areas make it easy and relaxing to color, and the first page says THIS BOOK BELONGS TO, ready for a name.

A fun birthday, party or travel gift for kids aged about 4 to 8 who love pirates and adventure, perfect for quiet time, car trips and rainy days.

DETAILS
- 24 coloring pages, one illustration per page
- Size: 8.5 x 11 in (21.6 x 27.9 cm)
- Flexible soft cover with a glossy full-colour pirate illustration
- Smooth, bright white 60 lb uncoated paper, great with crayons and colored pencils
- First page: THIS BOOK BELONGS TO, to write the child's name
- Recommended for ages 4 to 8

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes up to about 10 business days, so please order early for gifts. This item ships to the USA and Canada.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
